description: A program or function source unit WITHOUT the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header — ISO §2023:11.2.1 prints `[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ]` in brackets (rendered, PDF p293 / folio 263), so the unit may open directly on its PROGRAM-ID or FUNCTION-ID paragraph. X3.23-1985 required the header, so the header-less form is a 2002 relaxation. Parsed at every edition (superset-parse) so the below-2002 rejection is this named gate rather than `unexpected 'PROGRAM-ID'`. kb/Work PB829.
display: a source unit without the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header
citation: ISO §2023:11.2.1 (Identification division structure: `[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ]`) — 2002 relaxation of the '85 required header
vcr: 2002 relaxation: the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header is optional (§2023:11.2.1; the '85 format required it)
source:
PROGRAM-ID. IDHOPT.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 A PIC X VALUE "a".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DISPLAY A.
    STOP RUN.
